title: League Of Legends Pro League Match Predictor
description: In this project, we are analyzing professional competitive League of Legends esports game data that was gathered from Oracle's Elixer. This dataset provides post-match game data from official professional leagues spanning through various data collecting API's from 2014 to 2026.

title: The Demographical effects of UC Test Optional vs. Test Required Policy
description: The purpose of this project was to evaluate whether the University of California’s shift to test-optional admissions, implemented in Fall 2021, was associated with measurable changes in the racial diversity of UC applicants. Prior research has shown that standardized tests like the SAT are strongly correlated with socioeconomic and racial disparities, raising the question of whether removing test requirements might broaden the applicant pool. Motivated by this debate, we investigated whether diversity increased, decreased, or remained stable after the SAT/ACT requirement was eliminated.

title: NYC City Complaints (Bloomberg's Office Study)
description: Data Visualization of NYC City Complaints from Bloomberg's Office Study. This project aims to analyze and visualize the patterns and trends in complaints received by various city departments, providing insights into the most common issues faced by residents and the effectiveness of city services.
